title: Createlightly
description: Beautiful survival with Create, physic and other cool mods
body:
This is a Create-based modpack, which adds not only mechanisms, but also new biomes, mobs and other things for great survival. 
Also, the modpack includes **client optimization and utility mods!** 
You can build everything you want, from a single waterwheel to a 500,000-block airplane with Create Aeronautics. (_Set max-physics steps/sec to 60 minimum_)
Modpack also adds a lot of settings for every player type (custom fog start/end, on/off different animations, etc.) 

<details>
  <summary> System requirements for comfortable playing: </summary>
     Processor: Intel Core i7-9750H (~5900 Geekbench score)
     GPU: GTX 1650 4GB (~20000 Geekbench score)
     Storage: 1.4 GB free
     RAM: 10 GB for Minecraft (16 GB total)
  </details>
<details>
  <summary> Minimal system requirements: </summary>
     Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U (~2600–2800 Geekbench score)
     GPU: Intel UHD Graphics 620 (~4500 Geekbench score)
     Storage: 0.6 GB free
     RAM: 5 GB for Minecraft (8 GB total)
  </details>
